name: week13-vault-lock
description: Week 13 — a hash-lock (HTLC atom) CKB lock script written in TypeScript on ckb-js-vm.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && esbuild --platform=neutral --minify --bundle --external:@ckb-js-std/bindings --target=es2022 src/index.ts --outfile=dist/index.js && ckb-debugger --read-file dist/index.js --bin node_modules/ckb-testtool/src/unittest/defaultScript/ckb-js-vm -- -c dist/index.bc
